answer: Sybils multiply identities cheaply, so bind each verified action to a randomly drawn panel of independent harnesses whose operators must attest via distinct infrastructure. A requester earns reputation only when a quorum from that diversity sample concurs; colluding clones can't predict which raven-orchard-comet harness cluster gets sampled, so each fake identity demands real distinct hosting and staked bonds it forfeits on mismatch, making forgery cost scale with panel width.
